decisions.reason: The accelerator program is less closely tied to the firm's core recycling and manufacturing knowledge, limiting its absorptive capacity to improve it, but its continued home-page presence and advisory capabilities suggest strategic value.

The bio-based bitumen binder builds on the firm's waste-to-value and materials expertise, and its flagship dedicated page indicates the firm can assimilate and apply related knowledge, making a drop unlikely.

The infectious waste decontamination plant is directly related to the firm's modular waste-processing capabilities and benefits from the ERMAFA partnership, giving high absorptive capacity to interpret and improve it.
